title: Repair-to-Replace Credit on the Replacement System Installations Member Install Credit
content:
# Repair-to-replace credit

## Rule

The repair-to-replace credit adds to the member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract according to the repair parts and repair labor charges billed on the homeowner's Harbison service calls — the Repair and Emergency Service Calls invoices — in the 12 months before the date of handling, counted before any member discount:

- where they total at least $1500.00, the credit is every repair labor charge billed in that window;
- where they total at least $600.00 but less than $1500.00, the credit is the most recently posted repair labor charge, the labor line of the latest repair;
- where they total less than $600.00, no repair-to-replace credit is given.

## The total that decides the case

The total is the repair parts lines plus the repair labor lines on the Repair and Emergency Service Calls invoices posted in the 12 months, each at the amount billed before any member discount line. Diagnostic fees, refrigerant and other lines are not part of it.

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical service histories)

| Repair parts in 12 months | Repair labor in 12 months | Total | Repair-to-replace credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| $1100.00 | $480.00 (two labor lines, $200.00 then $280.00) | $1580.00 | $480.00 — every repair labor charge |
| $700.00 | $300.00 (one labor line) | $1000.00 | $300.00 — the latest repair labor charge |
| $400.00 | $199.99 | $599.99 | None |
| $350.00 | $250.00 | $600.00 | The latest repair labor charge — $600.00 is at least $600.00 |
